group: Ball Lost or Out of Bounds
title: When to Play a Provisional Ball
question: You think your ball may be out of bounds but are not certain. What should you do?

choices.text: Wait until you reach the area and decide.
Immediately declare the original ball lost.

explanation: To save time, a player may play a provisional ball under Rule 18.3 if they think their ball may be lost outside a penalty area or out of bounds. This allows the player to avoid a long walk back if the original ball is not found or is out of bounds.
